title: Physical quantity
description: A numeric leaf (scalar or homogeneous nested numeric array) with an explicit SI or declared unit. Enforced at load time by helpers.data_validation (errors name the file and dotted path). JSON object keys must not contain '.' — dotted paths are documentation only.

value.description: Finite number, or a homogeneous array (possibly nested) of finite numbers. Booleans are rejected; every leaf must be finite (NaN/inf are not physical). Caveat: PyYAML (YAML 1.1) parses exponent notation without a signed exponent (e.g. 1.0e6, 1.58e20) as a string, so authored decks may carry numeric strings where this schema says number; the loader (helpers.data_validation._number via coerce_number) accepts such numeric strings and coerces them to a finite float, so the loader is the effective contract.

unit.description: Unit of value. Use 1 for dimensionless. Temperatures in plant YAML are degC (lumped native); the segmented emitter converts to K. Microscopic poison cross-sections are b (barns) and poison flux is 1/(cm2.s); the segmented emitter converts those to m2 and 1/(m2.s). W/(m2.K) carries radial-stack film coefficients and kg/s the prescribed annular-loop mass flow (TASK-20260914-01 P1). Extending this list requires updating helpers.data_validation.SUPPORTED_UNITS in the same change.

doc.description: What this quantity is. Copied into data/CATALOG.md. Required (with source) on the plant identity quantities and the kinetics/decay_heat/materials sections; optional elsewhere.

source.description: Modelica path or paper provenance of the current digits. Required (with doc) on the plant identity quantities and the kinetics/decay_heat/materials sections; optional elsewhere.

provenance.description: Optional structured provenance block attached to the quantity itself (e.g. the k_mod correlation record: report, authors, material grade, correlation coefficients with units, evaluation temperature, unrounded/rounded results, rounding step). Free-form mapping; record-specific structure is validated by helpers.plant_config.
